content.what_it_is: GPU boundary/halo module variant. It defines masked-cell x/y flux kernels and a four-side physical flux driver (L1-L329); dispatches all dispersion fields through parity-coded `PHI_COLL_OUTER_GPU` (L340-L449); exchanges primary fields, fluxes, mask and breaking arrays through generic `PHI_COLL_GPU` and applies masks (L459-L533); provides variable-length reflection (L543-L613); implements full real ghost exchange with VTYPE parity classes 1-6 and MGPU neighbor exchange (L625-L1244); implements a second, nearly duplicated outer-only real collector without the final neighbor exchange (L1248-L1872); and implements integer mask exchange (L1876-L2064).
entities: module boundary_condition_module at L1 with cudafor/PARAM/GLOBAL/mod_cuda imports at L2-L35 and generic PHI_COLL_GPU interface at L38-L41
boundary_condition_X_kernel and boundary_condition_Y_kernel CUDA routines in approximately L57-L151
EXCHANGE_DISPERSION_GPU in approximately L340-L449 with local VTYPE
EXCHANGE_GPU in approximately L459-L533 with local VTYPE/I/J
PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH_GPU in approximately L543-L613 with bounds/VTYPE inputs and device real PHI INOUT
real PHI_COLL_GPU in approximately L625-L1244 with conditional PERIODIC argument and MGPU periodic buffers
real PHI_COLL_OUTER_GPU in approximately L1248-L1872 with the same VTYPE 1-6 reflection/periodic structure but no final MGPU neighbor exchange
integer PHI_COLL_INT_GPU in approximately L1876-L2064 with conditional PERIODIC argument and MGPU integer buffers

equations.ref: east coupled boundary flux in second excluded segment, continued at L214

io.name: flux, eta, mask, velocity, transport, breaking and dispersion arrays imported from mod_cuda

calls: boundary_condition_X_kernel and boundary_condition_Y_kernel launches around L304-L324 followed by cudaDeviceSynchronize
PHI_COLL_OUTER_GPU for every dispersion/derivative array in L340-L447, with VTYPE 1 for symmetric mixed fields, 2 for x-odd fields, and 3 for y-odd fields
PHI_COLL_GPU for primary Eta/breaking/mask/U/HU/V/HV and PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH_GPU for P/Q in L468-L514
MPI_SENDRECV plus cudaMemcpy2D in periodic portions of PHI_COLL_GPU, PHI_COLL_OUTER_GPU, and PHI_COLL_INT_GPU
phi_exch_cuda only at the ends of PHI_COLL_GPU around L1241 and PHI_COLL_INT_GPU around L2060
unresolved: MGPU dispersion halos are not exchanged across internal subdomains. `EXCHANGE_DISPERSION_GPU` routes every dispersion field through PHI_COLL_OUTER_GPU at L340-L447. PHI_COLL_OUTER_GPU performs physical-edge reflection and north/south periodic handling through L1872 but never calls `phi_exch_cuda`; only the primary real collector calls it around L1241 and the integer collector around L2060. Thus internal east/west/north/south neighbor halos for the derivative arrays remain stale in MGPU runs.

COUPLING east-boundary name defect: the first east excluded segment uses imported Gamma3, while the second uses undeclared `Gamma3_d` at L213. The restricted imports at L7-L35 contain Gamma3 but not Gamma3_d, so this conditional build path cannot resolve the identifier under IMPLICIT NONE.

Non-MGPU interface mismatch: boundary_condition_Y_kernel omits n_suth/n_nrth from its non-MGPU signature but unconditionally declares them with VALUE at L116. They are not dummy arguments in that configuration even though VALUE is a dummy-argument attribute.

The file says ETATx_d and ETATy_d seem unused and comments out their exchange around L365-L369. Their import remains, but whether downstream DISP_TIME_LEFT code truly never consumes their halos requires whole-program confirmation.
EXCHANGE_GPU states at L526-L527 that the CPU FILTERING preprocessing block is missing from the GPU version, leaving option-level CPU/GPU behavior divergence unresolved.

The real and integer periodic implementations pass Mloc-style pitches and widths to cudaMemcpy2D rather than explicitly byte-scaled values. The CUDA Fortran overload contract is external; if byte units apply, the copies under-transfer multi-byte elements.

PHI_COLL_OUTER_GPU duplicates hundreds of lines of PHI_COLL_GPU reflection logic but omits its final communication call. The duplication makes later parity/boundary fixes prone to diverge and is the direct source of the internal-halo inconsistency above.

Boundary kernels write neighbor indices through expanded Ibeg-1:Iend+1/Jbeg-1:Jend+1 ranges without receiving Mloc/Nloc, so safety depends on a caller-established ghost-width contract not checked here.
